name: 49Financial AUA + Account-Count Reconciliation v2
description: Second-pass reconciliation of Opal portal AUA + account counts against 49Financial's actual reported figures. Surface gaps: 49F displays 6611 accounts, Opal portal shows ~6025 (586 missing, ~8.86% undercount). 49F AUA is 3.59% higher than Opal portal's. ADVI_AUAVAR (closed 2026-03-09) achieved 99.1% accuracy at the time; current 96.41% suggests drift since then. Andrew directive 2026-05-01: another pass of investigation to identify where we are inaccurate, where we overshoot, where we undershoot, and what accounts we are not tracking.
phase: **Phase 0 CLOSED 2026-05-01 + Phase 1 IN FLIGHT.** Phase 0: 4-slice parallel discovery in ~1.5h wall-clock (`b527dfa14` dispatch → `21e65922d` consolidation). Verdict: 590 missing accounts × $62.4M AUA > $59.6M gap → CASE_A confirmed (gap is 100% scope-driven). Root cause: C_03 positions-required filter excludes 590 accounts in 4 buckets (A:44 non-investment, B:11 onboarding-lag, C1:60 large-recent $55M PRIMARY, C2/C3:475 dormant). Classification drift minor (E_25: 0.57% unknown). BKF FIX_PRESENT. Schwab dominant 91.1%; no cross-custodian gap. Schwab TRN NNA Phase 6 C_01 DISJOINT — keeps own track. Phase 1 split into 2 tracks per Andrew design 2026-05-01: **Track 1 (.002, DS~A)** D_04 extension to emit `gold/artifacts/49f/out_of_scope_accounts.json` for buckets A+B+C2/C3 (530 accts ~$3-5M; FE consumes). **Track 2 sub-investigation (.002.5, DS~B)** split C1 into C1a/C1b + custodian source-of-truth check + design recommendation (Option A allocation-as-fallback / B parallel path / C time-window). Track 2 fix TO authored after .002.5 RAVC4 + Andrew business-rule answers.
blocking: Track 2 fix gates on .002.5 sub-investigation RAVC4 + Andrew business-rule answers (5 open questions in recon doc). Track 1 (.002) has no gates.
